steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's the third time today, Sleeping Beauty.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How long was I out for?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: A dozen seconds or so.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Hoshiguma, step aside. I'll slash apart the debris.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sorry, but I can't do that. If I move, we're both done for. Let me handle this.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your shoulder.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It doesn't matter.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...You won't be able hold out much longer! You're holding up two floors' worth of rubble on top of your shield!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't need to for much longer. Just until you woke up... Squat down, and get ready to dash out.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No matter how heavy it is...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...as long as I can turn it over...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...it's not heavy at all!! AAAAAGH!!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Gaaah, aagh... Ngh... It feels like I lost my shoulder just to give it that little push.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You saved me again.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's weird about that? How many times does that make now? And don't say that to me so earnestly... makes me feel gross just hearing it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let me rest a little. I feel like I just broke every bone in my body... Maybe it's your turn to let me take a nap.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: ...Blast, how did they even survive all that?!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sure, but the enemy's not going to let you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No rest for the wicked, I suppose. Looks like I can still stand if I muster my strength.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You should go reorganize the squads, quickly. Don't waste any more time on them - it's what they're after.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't think it's too late to just take them all out first.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Why can't you go check to see who got injured first?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And leave you here to face Reunion alone despite all your injuries?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ch'en. What do you think you're doing?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Two years ago in Hua Shui, you were chasing after a bandit leader. My leg was injured, but you believed in me and left me to fight alone. Do you still remember that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: How long did it take me to catch him?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Three hours. You trusted me back then.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And I still do.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You, Reunion! I'll take you all on!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: Damn it... She's looking down at us!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I can still fight. Why are you staying behind? Why aren't you taking the squads to recapture the L.G.D. Headquarters? Did you forget your main mission?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's the same as it was three years ago, and it's a responsibility that only you can fulfill!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You did this back at the Muk Wo Warehouse earlier. When did you become so indecisive? Ch'en!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I don't see any problem with protecting my colleague from these rioters.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You've changed. You used to be much tougher.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Leaving you here? Of course I could. I used to only look at the risks versus the benefits, but now, it's as you said...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: After what I did to Amiya, I've also been... conflicted.

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You'll taste the rage of the Infected! Attack!

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Maybe I have changed. As time passed, I've had fewer grievances about Lungmen, and I've been able to place my trust in more people.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: You are no longer just Inspector Hoshiguma. You are my friend, and my partner.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Your shield has protected me all this time; so once in a while, you should let me be your shield.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Whew. You're not even going to blush after saying all that?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Shut the **** up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hahaha.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: All right, all right. In that case, Ch'en, I'm leaving it to you.
